title: Add your own search engine
claim: Built behind the Search setting. You add a name, a shortcut and a URL; typing the shortcut first searches that engine.

views.know:
Adding an engine takes a name, a shortcut and a URL with %s where your words go. Save stays off until the URL has one. [^2]

Typing the shortcut first in the address bar searches that engine; anything else goes to the default, Google. [^3]
